source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: net-snmp + vendor MIB + BMC SNMP enabled (2nd host)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SysInfo MIB data browses vendor BMC MIB data with a MIB browser (e.g. iReasoning) from a management host after SNMP is enabled; agent can instead read the equivalent Redfish inventory: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Systems/system 2>&1 | head -60 and the BMC MIB subtree once the vendor MIB + community are configured on the 2nd host.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL Redfish system-inventory JSON + (if present) the snmpwalk of the vendor MIB root so the user confirms the "+it+" data is complete and matches.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires the vendor SNMP MIB + a MIB-browser host and an enabled BMC SNMP agent; the Redfish read is the agent-provided alternative evidence.

original_test_intent: Collect the approved finite System Information MIB dataset over SNMPv3 and compare values to authoritative platform inventory.
original_method: Engineer configures v3 and browses undefined `$target`; Criteria switch client without listing fields.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3 and supplies the approved field set; collection and comparison can then be automated.
safety_requirements: Read only and bound the field set.
Protect v3 secrets, serials and asset identifiers.
Do not replace SNMP proof with unverified Redfish output.
agent_execution_scope: After setup, query exact SysInfo objects, normalize and compare to approved inventory; collect secure corroboration only if mapped.
Do not operate WebUI or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve field/source mapping and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Hard-coded Redfish path, curl -k/u and head truncation cannot prove SNMP completeness or secure equivalence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor SysInfo SNMPv3 OIDs; discover and map any optional Redfish cross-check with trusted TLS.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define a finite SysInfo schema, collect each SNMPv3 object and compare normalized values against one authoritative inventory source.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SysInfo MIB and inventory schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic schema and source mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents partial/truncated generic output from claiming completeness.

project_override_considerations: Project chooses its approved SysInfo field set and authoritative source and reports omissions explicitly.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure/Criteria use different clients with undefined `$target`; DeepSeek substitutes unsafe/truncated Redfish and malformed output wording.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Field set and expected inventory are project inputs; manual setup followed by bounded automated collection is feasible.
